name: Dropkick Rick
source:
You play as Rick, a has-been wrestler with too much confidence and too little luck. He’s impulsive, stubborn, full of bravado, but also weirdly charming in his cluelessness. Through branching choices and comic-strip storytelling, you’ll stumble through everything from awkward promos to bizarre dates to questionable career moves.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3850170/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你扮演瑞克，一个过气的摔跤手，信心十足，运气却太差。他冲动、固执、虚张声势，但又在他的无知中有着奇异的魅力。通过分支选择和漫画故事讲述，你会跌跌撞撞地经历一切，从尴尬的宣传片到奇怪的约会，再到可疑的职业变动。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3850170/]Steam[/url]]
